questions.stemHtml: A 45-year female presented to the opd with complaints of an ulcer over the left leg for 3 months. On examination, left leg edema was present with dilated tortuous veins along the medial aspect of the leg. which of the following statement is incorrect regarding ulcer

options.label: A
options.text: Ulceration can develop with long-standing venous hypertension

options.label: B
options.text: It is associated with alteration in microcirculatory and cutaneous lymphatic anatomy and function

options.label: C
options.text: Most common location of venous ulceration is approximately 5cm proximal to the medial malleolus
